tool_selection.reasoning: SHAP provides a clear attribution of how marital-status contributes to the prediction, showing its relative impact compared to other features. Sensitivity analysis directly simulates removing the feature by setting it to zero or a baseline value, measuring the shift in prediction probability—this gives direct evidence of prediction change.
